messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor here. We need consolidated evidence for SOC 2 control set covering:
- RBAC change approvals (policy, PRs, approver signatures)
- KMS key rotation logs & rotation schedule proof
- Audit log retention and export (cloudtrail/splunk)
- Recent vuln triage notes plus link to associated incidents
Can you confirm what artifacts we'll provide, sampling approach, and whether anything needs redaction? Need by EOD Thu. Thanks.

sarah: Thanks Jane. We'll assemble a single evidence bundle with a control map. Plan:
1) RBAC: PR diffs, approval audit trail, ephemeral role justification docs, sample of role_binding snapshots.
2) KMS: rotation events (CloudKMS/KeyVault), rotation schedule csv, signed key-material-change manifest.
3) Logs: CloudTrail + ALB + app logs export for sample window (30 days), plus Splunk query output and hash.
4) Vuln triage: list of JIRA tickets, triage notes, fix/mitigation artifacts, and incident postmortems if applicable.

sarah: We'll also include a chain-of-custody file with SHA256 checksums for each exported artifact and a CSV index. We'll redact user emails in screenshots and provide a redacted/unredacted mapping for the auditor review process.

mika: Quick Q — what's our sampling policy? For RBAC changes we typically provide most recent 25 changes + all emergency changes last 12 months. For logs, auditor usually accepts 7-day window + targeted day-of-incident slices.

sarah: Right. Proposed sampling:
- RBAC: last 25 non-service-account role changes + all emergency/privilege escalations in 12mo.
- KMS: last 3 rotations + rotation policy doc + rotation runbook.
- Logs: 7-day rolling sample + any incident windows (we'll include the exact UTC ranges).

dan: Copy of the queries we'll export — put these in the bundle too.
Splunk sample:
```
index=prod_logs sourcetype=cloudtrail eventName=CreateKey OR eventName=RotateKey | table _time userName eventName requestParameters
```
CloudTrail sample (aws cli):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2024-08-01 --end-time 2024-08-31
```
We'll export as CSV and gzip.

sarah: Assigning tasks: @mika collect RBAC PRs + screenshots; @dan run log exports and attach query results; I'll compile KMS rotation artifacts and create the chain-of-custody CSV.

ops-bot: Export job 9932 queued by dan for /evidence/exports/9932 (uid=ops-9932)

ops-bot: Export job 9932 completed — files: /evidence/exports/9932/cloudtrail_rotatekey_20240801-20240831.csv.gz (sha256: 3f7b9c2a...) and /evidence/exports/9932/splunk_rbac_202409.gz (sha256: b1a4d2e4...)

auditor_jane: Thanks — can you include the signed rotation policy (who approved rotation cadence) and the authorization matrix for emergency key access? Also need linkage between vuln ticket JIRA-SEC-2345 and incident IR-2024-07-21.

sarah: Will include signed rotation policy PDF (approvers: CTO, security-head) and access matrix csv. Linking JIRA-SEC-2345 -> IR-2024-07-21 in the evidence_manifest.csv. Example triage excerpt:
```
JIRA-SEC-2345: High - container image vuln discovered by snyk scanner. Mitigation: pinned base image + feature flag rollback. CVE referenced: CVE-2024-XXXX. Status: fixed (PR #5678). Postmortem: /docs/postmortems/IR-2024-07-21.md
```

mika: RBAC PRs: PR# 789 (service-account rename), PR#801 (role-tighten), approvals: sarah, dan, infra-lead. I've attached diffs to the bundle.

auditor_jane: One last thing — we need assurance no PII left unredacted in logs. Can you confirm redaction process and provide a sample file and the redaction script?

sarah: Confirmed. We'll include the redaction script (python) and a sample before/after file. Redaction script replaces emails and IPs with hashed tokens and logs substitutions to a separate secure mapping file (not in redacted bundle; available on request under NDA).

auditor_jane: Perfect, thanks. ETA?

sarah: We'll deliver the bundle link by Thu 18:00 UTC. I'll post the export link here when ready. :thumbsup:
